<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C₁₄H₁₂O₆), the DBE (9), the presence of one carbonyl and one methyl group, and the predominance of aromatic carbons, a reasonable fragmentation would be a small aliphatic carbonyl fragment (the methyl‑acetate moiety) and an aromatic di‑hydroxy fragment. These two pieces can be joined through an ester linkage to give a structure that matches the formula and the NMR data.</thought>
<final_answer>['COC(=O)C', 'c1ccc(O)cc1O']</final_answer>
